meanings.en: the pleasure you get from something
meanings.exampleEn: She read the book purely for enjoyment.
meanings.exampleTr: Kitabı sadece keyif için okudu.

meanings.en: to improve the quality or value of something
meanings.exampleEn: Travel can enrich your understanding of other cultures.
meanings.exampleTr: Seyahat, diğer kültürlere dair anlayışınızı zenginleştirebilir.

meanings.en: to make certain that something happens
meanings.exampleEn: Please ensure that the door is locked before leaving.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen ayrılmadan önce kapının kilitli olduğundan emin olun.

meanings.en: to amuse or interest people
meanings.exampleEn: The clown entertained the children at the party.
meanings.exampleTr: Palyaço partide çocukları eğlendirdi.

meanings.en: a person who performs to amuse an audience
meanings.exampleEn: He is a talented entertainer who can sing and dance.
meanings.exampleTr: O, hem şarkı söyleyip hem dans edebilen yetenekli bir şovmendir.

meanings.en: a strong feeling of interest and excitement
meanings.exampleEn: The students greeted the new project with great enthusiasm.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğrenciler yeni projeyi büyük bir coşkuyla karşıladı.

meanings.en: a person who is very interested in an activity
meanings.exampleEn: He is a car enthusiast who spends weekends fixing engines.
meanings.exampleTr: O, hafta sonlarını motor tamir ederek geçiren bir araba meraklısıdır.

meanings.en: showing strong interest and excitement
meanings.exampleEn: She was enthusiastic about joining the new team.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni takıma katılma konusunda hevesliydi.

meanings.en: whole; with no part left out
meanings.exampleEn: They spent the entire day at the beach.
meanings.exampleTr: Bütün günü plajda geçirdiler.

meanings.en: completely; in every way
meanings.exampleEn: The decision is entirely up to you.
meanings.exampleTr: Karar tamamen sana bağlı.

meanings.en: the act of entering, or the way in
meanings.exampleEn: The sign said 'No entry' on the locked door.
meanings.exampleTr: Kilitli kapıda 'Giriş yok' yazan bir tabela vardı.

meanings.en: relating to the natural world or surroundings
meanings.exampleEn: Pollution causes serious environmental problems.
meanings.exampleTr: Kirlilik ciddi çevresel sorunlara yol açar.

meanings.en: a person who works to protect the environment
meanings.exampleEn: The environmentalist campaigned to save the forest.
meanings.exampleTr: Çevreci, ormanı kurtarmak için kampanya yürüttü.

meanings.en: the same in amount, value, or status
meanings.exampleEn: Everyone should have equal rights under the law.
meanings.exampleTr: Herkesin yasa önünde eşit hakları olmalıdır.

meanings.en: the state of being equal
meanings.exampleEn: They fought for racial equality.
meanings.exampleTr: Irksal eşitlik için mücadele ettiler.

meanings.en: in the same way or to the same degree
meanings.exampleEn: The money was divided equally among the three children.
meanings.exampleTr: Para üç çocuk arasında eşit olarak bölündü.

meanings.en: the tools or machines needed for an activity
meanings.exampleEn: The laboratory has modern equipment for experiments.
meanings.exampleTr: Laboratuvarda deneyler için modern ekipman var.

meanings.en: a long period of history
meanings.exampleEn: The invention of the internet began a new era.
meanings.exampleTr: İnternetin icadı yeni bir çağ başlattı.

meanings.en: the most important quality of something
meanings.exampleEn: Freedom is the essence of democracy.
meanings.exampleTr: Özgürlük, demokrasinin özüdür.

meanings.en: completely necessary
meanings.exampleEn: Water is essential for all forms of life.
meanings.exampleTr: Su, tüm yaşam biçimleri için gereklidir.

meanings.en: the act of starting an organization, or the organization itself
meanings.exampleEn: The establishment of the new school took two years.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni okulun kuruluşu iki yıl sürdü.

meanings.en: lasting forever
meanings.exampleEn: They promised each other eternal love.
meanings.exampleTr: Birbirlerine sonsuz aşk sözü verdiler.

meanings.en: time that has no end
meanings.exampleEn: Waiting for the results felt like an eternity.
meanings.exampleTr: Sonuçları beklemek bir sonsuzluk gibi hissettirdi.

meanings.en: flat, level, or equal
meanings.exampleEn: Make sure the table stands on an even surface.
meanings.exampleTr: Masanın düz bir zemin üzerinde durduğundan emin olun.

meanings.en: in equal amounts or a regular way
meanings.exampleEn: Spread the butter evenly over the bread.
meanings.exampleTr: Tereyağını ekmeğin üzerine eşit olarak sürün.

meanings.en: in the end, after a long time
meanings.exampleEn: After many attempts, he eventually passed the exam.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok denemeden sonra sonunda sınavı geçti.

meanings.en: easy to see or understand
meanings.exampleEn: It was evident that she had been crying.
meanings.exampleTr: Ağladığı açıkça belliydi.

meanings.en: completely correct and precise
meanings.exampleEn: Can you tell me the exact time of the meeting?
meanings.exampleTr: Bana toplantının tam saatini söyleyebilir misin?

meanings.en: a careful inspection or a test
meanings.exampleEn: The doctor gave him a thorough examination.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktor ona kapsamlı bir muayene yaptı.

meanings.en: to look at something carefully
meanings.exampleEn: The scientist examined the sample under a microscope.
meanings.exampleTr: Bilim insanı örneği mikroskop altında inceledi.

meanings.en: a person who tests students' knowledge
meanings.exampleEn: The examiner asked her several difficult questions.
meanings.exampleTr: Sınav görevlisi ona birkaç zor soru sordu.

meanings.en: the quality of being extremely good
meanings.exampleEn: The school is known for its academic excellence.
meanings.exampleTr: Okul, akademik mükemmelliğiyle tanınır.

meanings.en: an amount that is more than necessary
meanings.exampleEn: An excess of sugar in your diet is unhealthy.
meanings.exampleTr: Beslenmenizdeki şeker fazlalığı sağlıksızdır.

meanings.en: in a happy and eager way
meanings.exampleEn: The children talked excitedly about the trip.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar gezi hakkında heyecanla konuştu.

meanings.en: a feeling of being very happy and eager
meanings.exampleEn: There was great excitement before the concert began.
meanings.exampleTr: Konser başlamadan önce büyük bir heyecan vardı.

meanings.en: limited to one person or group; not shared
meanings.exampleEn: The club is exclusive and accepts only a few members.
meanings.exampleTr: Kulüp seçkindir ve yalnızca birkaç üye kabul eder.

meanings.en: extremely tired
meanings.exampleEn: After the long hike, they were completely exhausted.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun yürüyüşten sonra tamamen bitkindiler.

meanings.en: the state of being or living
meanings.exampleEn: Scientists searched for evidence of life's existence on Mars.
meanings.exampleTr: Bilim insanları Mars'taki yaşamın varlığına dair kanıt aradılar.

meanings.en: a way out of a place
meanings.exampleEn: In an emergency, use the nearest exit.
meanings.exampleTr: Acil durumda en yakın çıkışı kullanın.

meanings.en: to become or make larger
meanings.exampleEn: The company plans to expand into new markets.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket yeni pazarlara açılmayı planlıyor.

meanings.en: the money spent on something
meanings.exampleEn: The expense of the trip was higher than expected.
meanings.exampleTr: Gezinin masrafı beklenenden yüksekti.

meanings.en: having knowledge or skill from doing something
meanings.exampleEn: She is an experienced teacher with twenty years of work.
meanings.exampleTr: Yirmi yıllık çalışmasıyla deneyimli bir öğretmendir.

meanings.en: a scientific test to discover something
meanings.exampleEn: The students carried out an experiment in chemistry class.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğrenciler kimya dersinde bir deney yaptılar.

meanings.en: the act of traveling or searching to discover something
meanings.exampleEn: Space exploration has revealed many secrets of the universe.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzay keşfi, evrenin birçok sırrını ortaya çıkardı.

meanings.en: a sudden violent burst of energy
meanings.exampleEn: The explosion shook the entire building.
meanings.exampleTr: Patlama tüm binayı sarstı.

meanings.en: to uncover or make something visible
meanings.exampleEn: The report exposed serious problems in the system.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor, sistemdeki ciddi sorunları ortaya çıkardı.

meanings.en: to make something longer or larger
meanings.exampleEn: They decided to extend their holiday by a week.
meanings.exampleTr: Tatillerini bir hafta uzatmaya karar verdiler.

meanings.en: to a large degree; thoroughly
meanings.exampleEn: He has traveled extensively throughout Asia.
meanings.exampleTr: Asya boyunca geniş ölçüde seyahat etti.

meanings.en: how large or great something is
meanings.exampleEn: We were surprised by the extent of the damage.
meanings.exampleTr: Hasarın kapsamına şaşırdık.

meanings.en: no longer existing as a species
meanings.exampleEn: Dinosaurs became extinct millions of years ago.
meanings.exampleTr: Dinozorların nesli milyonlarca yıl önce tükendi.

meanings.en: the state of a species no longer existing
meanings.exampleEn: Many animals are threatened with extinction.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok hayvan yok olma tehlikesiyle karşı karşıyadır.

meanings.en: very unusual or remarkable
meanings.exampleEn: She showed extraordinary courage during the crisis.
meanings.exampleTr: Kriz sırasında olağanüstü bir cesaret gösterdi.

meanings.en: very great in degree
meanings.exampleEn: The desert has extreme temperatures during the day.
meanings.exampleTr: Çölde gün boyunca aşırı sıcaklıklar görülür.

meanings.en: dangerous and exciting sporting activities
meanings.exampleEn: He loves extreme sports such as skydiving and rock climbing.
meanings.exampleTr: Paraşütle atlama ve kaya tırmanışı gibi ekstrem sporları sever.

meanings.en: the ability to see
meanings.exampleEn: Her eyesight got worse as she grew older.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaşlandıkça görme yetisi kötüleşti.

meanings.en: in person, with someone directly present
meanings.exampleEn: We finally met face to face after years of emails.
meanings.exampleTr: Yıllarca süren e-postalardan sonra nihayet yüz yüze tanıştık.

meanings.en: happening with people directly present
meanings.exampleEn: They prefer a face-to-face meeting rather than a phone call.
meanings.exampleTr: Telefon görüşmesi yerine yüz yüze bir toplantıyı tercih ederler.

meanings.en: a place or service provided for a purpose
meanings.exampleEn: The hotel has excellent sports facilities.
meanings.exampleTr: Otelin mükemmel spor tesisleri var.

meanings.en: to become less bright, strong, or clear
meanings.exampleEn: The colors of the curtains began to fade in the sun.
meanings.exampleTr: Perdelerin renkleri güneşte solmaya başladı.

meanings.en: a lack of success, or a breakdown
meanings.exampleEn: The project ended in failure due to poor planning.
meanings.exampleTr: Proje, kötü planlama nedeniyle başarısızlıkla sonuçlandı.

meanings.en: not strong or clear; slight
meanings.exampleEn: There was a faint smell of smoke in the room.
meanings.exampleTr: Odada hafif bir duman kokusu vardı.

meanings.en: loyal and able to be trusted
meanings.exampleEn: A dog is a faithful companion to its owner.
meanings.exampleTr: Köpek, sahibine sadık bir dosttur.

meanings.en: not real; made to look genuine
meanings.exampleEn: She was wearing a fake fur coat.
meanings.exampleTr: Sahte bir kürk manto giyiyordu.

meanings.en: having dropped to the ground
meanings.exampleEn: The path was covered with fallen leaves.
meanings.exampleTr: Yol, düşmüş yapraklarla kaplıydı.

meanings.en: an imagined situation that is not real
meanings.exampleEn: As a child, he lived in a world of fantasy.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocukken bir fantezi dünyasında yaşardı.

meanings.en: distant; a long way away
meanings.exampleEn: She dreamed of traveling to faraway countries.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzak ülkelere seyahat etmeyi hayal ederdi.

meanings.en: an act of saying goodbye
meanings.exampleEn: They held a farewell party for the retiring teacher.
meanings.exampleTr: Emekli olan öğretmen için bir veda partisi düzenlediler.

meanings.en: the activity of growing crops or raising animals
meanings.exampleEn: Farming is the main source of income in this region.
meanings.exampleTr: Çiftçilik, bu bölgedeki ana gelir kaynağıdır.

meanings.en: land used for farming
meanings.exampleEn: Much of the farmland was flooded after the heavy rain.
meanings.exampleTr: Şiddetli yağmurdan sonra tarım arazisinin büyük kısmı sular altında kaldı.

meanings.en: at or to a greater distance
meanings.exampleEn: We walked farther down the road to find a taxi.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir taksi bulmak için yolda daha ileriye yürüdük.
